<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>E-Office Flow</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sarabun:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: sticky top bar + routed views (write / stats / security); split brand panel + form card for sign-in. Navy primary, small gold accent. */
:root{
  --bg:#EDF1FA; --solid:#FFFFFF; --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.42); --ink:#0E2240; --muted:#52627F; --line:rgba(22,52,110,.16);
  --primary:#1D4FA8; --primary-ink:#FFFFFF; --primary-soft:rgba(37,84,190,.10); --gold:#B07F2A;
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#1B4F9E 0%,#4B5BD8 55%,#8A5CF0 100%);
  --danger:#B3261E; --ok:#1B7F4F; --warn:#946200; --field:rgba(255,255,255,.74);
  --brand-bg:rgba(10,28,70,.78); --brand-ink:#EAF0FA; --brand-muted:#B3C2DE;
  --b1:#7BA7FF; --b2:#B79BFF; --b3:#6FE3D4; --b4:#FFB6D5; --spot:rgba(88,120,255,.16); --dots:rgba(30,60,130,.12);
  --paper:#FFFFFF; --paper-ink:#111111; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(14,34,64,.08),0 14px 40px rgba(14,34,64,.10);
  --ui:"Sarabun","TH Sarabun New","THSarabunNew","Noto Sans Thai",system-ui,sans-serif; --doc:"Sarabun","TH Sarabun New",serif;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#080E1C; --solid:#131D32; --surface:rgba(22,32,56,.42); --ink:#E8EEF9; --muted:#9AA9C4; --line:rgba(160,185,255,.17);
  --primary:#86AEFF; --primary-ink:#FFFFFF; --primary-soft:rgba(110,150,255,.14); --gold:#D4A64F;
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F5FD0 0%,#5B52D6 55%,#8656E6 100%);
  --danger:#F08A82; --ok:#5CC38E; --warn:#E7B35C; --field:rgba(8,14,28,.55); --brand-bg:rgba(8,18,44,.72);
  --b1:#2C59D6; --b2:#6B3FD0; --b3:#0C8F88; --b4:#A63A78; --spot:rgba(130,160,255,.14); --dots:rgba(170,190,255,.10);
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4); color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#080E1C; --solid:#131D32; --surface:rgba(22,32,56,.42); --ink:#E8EEF9; --muted:#9AA9C4; --line:rgba(160,185,255,.17);
  --primary:#86AEFF; --primary-ink:#FFFFFF; --primary-soft:rgba(110,150,255,.14); --gold:#D4A64F;
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F5FD0 0%,#5B52D6 55%,#8656E6 100%);
  --danger:#F08A82; --ok:#5CC38E; --warn:#E7B35C; --field:rgba(8,14,28,.55); --brand-bg:rgba(8,18,44,.72);
  --b1:#2C59D6; --b2:#6B3FD0; --b3:#0C8F88; --b4:#A63A78; --spot:rgba(130,160,255,.14); --dots:rgba(170,190,255,.10);
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4); color-scheme:dark}

*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--ui);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.5;margin:0;
  padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));padding-block:0 40px}
button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
a{color:var(--primary)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary);outline-offset:2px}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;line-height:1.3}
.wrap{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto}


.logo-img{display:block;height:38px;width:auto;max-width:100%}
.auth-side .logo-img{height:56px;filter:invert(1)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .bar .logo-img{filter:invert(1)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .bar .logo-img{filter:invert(1)}
/* top bar */
.bar{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);margin-inline:calc(-1*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))) calc(-1*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)));
  padding-inline:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.bar-in{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 24px;padding-block:10px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.logo svg{width:32px;height:32px;flex:none}
.logo small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0;margin-top:-3px}
nav.tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;flex:1;min-width:0;order:3;width:100%;scrollbar-width:none}
nav.tabs a{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
nav.tabs a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-soft)}
nav.tabs a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.who{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;flex:none}
.who .nm{min-width:0;line-height:1.2;display:none}
.who .nm b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:200px}
.who .nm span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:200px}
@media (min-width:640px){.who .nm{display:block}}
@media (min-width:900px){nav.tabs{order:0;width:auto}}

.main{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding-block:22px 10px}
.page-head{margin-bottom:16px}
.page-head h1{font-size:24px}
.page-head p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);max-width:70ch}

/* controls */
.btn{border:1px solid var(--primary);background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-ink);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--primary)}
.btn.danger{background:var(--danger);border-color:var(--danger);color:#fff}
.btn.ghost.danger{background:transparent;color:var(--danger)}
.btn.sm{padding:6px 12px;font-size:13.5px}
.btn.wide{width:100%}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
.btn.g{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;width:100%}
.btn.g:hover{border-color:var(--primary)}
.btn.g svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.badge{font-size:11px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary);border-radius:99px;padding:1px 8px;font-weight:600}
.chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 13px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-ink);border-color:var(--primary)}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:18px}
.card+.card{margin-top:14px}
.card h2{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:12px}
label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 4px}
.card label:first-of-type{margin-top:0}
input[type=text],input[type=date],input[type=email],input[type=password],textarea,select{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--field);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;min-width:0}
textarea{resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
input:focus,textarea:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--primary)}
.row-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;align-items:center}
.status{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);min-height:1.5em;margin-top:8px}
.status.err{color:var(--danger)}
.alert{border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--primary-soft);margin-bottom:12px}
.alert.warn{border-color:var(--warn);background:transparent;color:var(--warn)}
.alert.err{border-color:var(--danger);background:transparent;color:var(--danger)}
.alert.ok{border-color:var(--ok);background:transparent;color:var(--ok)}
.alert b{font-weight:600}

/* auth */
.auth{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,6fr);min-height:100vh;margin-inline:calc(-1*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))) calc(-1*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)))}
.auth-side{background:var(--brand-bg);color:var(--brand-ink);padding:48px max(32px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)) 48px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px;justify-content:center}
.auth-side .logo{color:#fff}
.auth-side .logo small{color:var(--brand-muted)}
.auth-side h1{font-size:34px;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.2}
.auth-side p{margin:0;color:var(--brand-muted);max-width:42ch}
.auth-side ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:14px}
.auth-side li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;max-width:46ch}
.auth-side li i{flex:none;width:8px;height:8px;margin-top:9px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--gold)}
.auth-side li b{display:block;font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.auth-side li span{color:var(--brand-muted);font-size:14px}
.auth-main{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:32px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) 32px 16px}
.auth-card{width:100%;max-width:440px}
.auth-card h2{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:4px}
.auth-card .sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 16px;font-size:14px}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:var(--primary-soft);border-radius:10px;padding:4px;margin-bottom:18px}
.seg button{border:0;background:transparent;padding:8px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
.seg button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(14,34,64,.15)}
.divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin:16px 0}
.divider::before,.divider::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.pwrow{position:relative}
.pwrow button{position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--primary);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;padding:4px 8px}
.pwrow input{padding-right:64px}
.meter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
.meter i{height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--line)}
.meter[data-s="1"] i:nth-child(-n+1),.meter[data-s="2"] i:nth-child(-n+2){background:var(--danger)}
.meter[data-s="3"] i:nth-child(-n+3){background:var(--warn)}
.meter[data-s="4"] i:nth-child(-n+4),.meter[data-s="5"] i:nth-child(-n+5){background:var(--ok)}
.hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.linkbtn{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--primary);cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:600;padding:0;text-decoration:underline}
.reccode{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:clamp(17px,4.6vw,22px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-align:center;padding:16px 10px;margin:14px 0;border-radius:12px;border:1px dashed var(--primary);background:var(--primary-soft);user-select:all;word-break:break-all}
.rec .auth-card{max-width:520px;margin:0 auto}
.check-line{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:14px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink)}
.check-line input{margin-top:5px;flex:none}
.ginfo{font-size:13.5px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:10px;background:var(--primary-soft)}
.ginfo ol{margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:4px}
@media (max-width:860px){.auth{grid-template-columns:1fr}.auth-side{padding:28px 24px;gap:16px}.auth-side h1{font-size:26px}.auth-side ul{display:none}.auth-main{padding-block:24px}}

/* write view */
.types{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px;margin-bottom:14px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.types button{flex:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
.types button b{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.types button span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.types button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--primary);border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-ink)}
.types button[aria-selected="true"] span{color:inherit;opacity:.8}
.mobtabs{display:none;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}
.mobtabs button{flex:1;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.mobtabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-ink);border-color:var(--primary)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,440px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:start}
.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.ideas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}
.ideas button{border:1px dashed var(--line);background:transparent;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);text-align:left}
.ideas button:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--primary)}
.check{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:13.5px}
.check li{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}
.check .ok{color:var(--ok)} .check .warn{color:var(--warn)}
.check i{font-style:normal;font-weight:600;width:1.1em;flex:none}
.previewbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px}
.previewbar .note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.stage{position:relative;width:100%;overflow:hidden;border-radius:6px}
.paper{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:21cm;min-height:29.7cm;transform-origin:0 0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--paper-ink);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-family:var(--doc);font-size:16pt;line-height:1.2;padding:1.5cm 2cm 2cm 3cm;
  background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent calc(29.7cm - 2px),rgba(120,130,150,.45) calc(29.7cm - 2px),rgba(120,130,150,.45) 29.7cm);background-size:100% 29.7cm}
.paper .embrow{width:15cm;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start}
.paper .embrow img{display:block;width:auto}
.paper .emb{width:var(--s);height:var(--s);border:1.5px dashed #9AA2B2;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;color:#8C94A6;text-align:center;line-height:1.1;flex:none}
.paper .memohead{position:relative;height:1.5cm;display:flex;align-items:center}
.paper .memohead img{height:1.5cm;width:auto;flex:none}
.paper .memohead h2{position:absolute;left:0;width:15cm;margin:0;text-align:center;font-size:29pt;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5cm}
.paper .row{display:flex;gap:.3em;align-items:baseline}
.paper .lb{flex:none}
.paper .lb.big{font-size:20pt;font-weight:700}
.paper .vl{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .vl.dots{border-bottom:1.5px dotted #333;min-height:1.1em}
.paper .row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7.5cm minmax(0,1fr)}
.paper .row2 .row:first-child{padding-right:.2cm}
.paper .c{text-align:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .para{margin:0;text-indent:2.5cm;text-align:justify;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .item{display:flex;margin-left:2.5cm}
.paper .item .n{flex:none;width:1cm}
.paper .item .t{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:justify;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .headl{text-align:justify;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .gap{height:1.2em}
.paper .x0{margin-left:7.5cm;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7.5cm minmax(0,1fr)}
.paper .split>div{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .foot{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.paper .sealrow{margin-left:6.5cm;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:.5cm;height:4.5cm}
.paper .sealbox{width:4.5cm;height:4.5cm;display:grid;place-items:center}
.paper .sealbox img{max-width:4.5cm;max-height:4.5cm}
.paper .seal{width:4.5cm;height:4.5cm;border:1.5px dashed #C0626C;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;color:#B07A80;text-align:center;line-height:1.15}
.paper .ini{padding-bottom:.2cm}
@media (max-width:960px){
  .grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .mobtabs{display:flex}
  .grid[data-pane="form"] .pane-preview{display:none}
  .grid[data-pane="preview"] .pane-form{display:none}
}

/* stats + security */
/* library, dashboard, landing, command palette */
.cmdbtn kbd{margin-left:8px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;padding:1px 6px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:640px){.cmdbtn kbd{display:none}}
.lbrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}
.lbrow .linkbtn{font-size:13px}
.backlink{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px}
.backlink:hover{color:var(--primary)}
.libbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.libbar input{flex:1 1 220px;min-width:0}
.empty{padding:28px 12px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.librow{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;margin-top:8px;background:var(--field)}
.lr-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,150px) minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;gap:10px 14px;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px}
.lr-no{font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.lr-t b{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.lr-t span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.lr-act{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lr-st{width:auto;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px}
.lr-st[data-s="1"],.lr-st[data-s="2"]{border-color:var(--warn);color:var(--warn)}
.lr-st[data-s="3"],.lr-st[data-s="4"]{border-color:var(--ok);color:var(--ok)}
.lr-more{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 14px}
.verrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:13.5px}
@media (max-width:760px){.lr-main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto}.lr-no,.lr-t{grid-column:1/-1}}
.numgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
.sub-h{font-weight:600;margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:14px}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:10px}
.tile{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;background:var(--field);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.tile b{display:block}.tile span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.hrow{display:flex;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;padding:10px 4px;cursor:pointer;align-items:center}
.hrow:hover{background:var(--primary-soft)}
.hno{flex:none;min-width:70px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ht{min-width:0}.ht b{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ht small{color:var(--muted)}
#cmdk .cmd-back{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,12,30,.45);display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding:12vh 16px 16px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.cmd-box{width:min(560px,100%);background:var(--solid);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.cmd-box input{width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;padding:16px;font-size:17px;background:transparent;outline:0}
#cmdList{max-height:50vh;overflow:auto;padding:6px}
.cmd-it{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
.cmd-it[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--primary-soft)}
.cmd-it small{color:var(--muted)}
.cmd-foot{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:8px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.wl{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding-bottom:20px}
.wl-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px 24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-block:16px}
.wl-nav{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-left:12px}
.wl-nav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}.wl-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.wl-cta{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media (max-width:640px){.wl-nav{display:none}}
.wl-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,.9fr);gap:32px;align-items:center;padding-block:36px 24px}
@media (max-width:860px){.wl-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.wl-pill{display:inline-block;padding:4px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.wl-copy h1{font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,50px);line-height:1.15;margin:14px 0;text-wrap:balance}
.wl-copy h1 em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.wl-copy p{font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);max-width:56ch}
.wl-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.wl-actions .btn{padding:12px 22px;font-size:16px}
.wl-trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 18px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.wl-trust li::before{content:"✓ ";color:var(--ok);font-weight:700}
.wl-mock{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16px}
.wl-paper{width:min(320px,100%);aspect-ratio:210/297;background:#fff;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:9% 10%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;transform:rotate(-2.5deg)}
.wl-paper i{display:block;height:7px;border-radius:4px;background:#D5DAE5;width:100%}
.wl-paper p{margin:4px 0}
.wl-paper.wl-doc{width:min(400px,100%);padding:0;display:block;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.wl-doc .paper{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform-origin:0 0;background-image:none;box-shadow:none;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.wl-emb{width:16%;aspect-ratio:1;border:2px dashed #AEB6C8;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 6px}
.wl-badge{position:absolute;background:var(--solid);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.wl-badge.b1{top:62%;right:0;color:var(--ok)}.wl-badge.b2{bottom:14%;left:0;color:var(--primary)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.wl-paper{animation:wlf 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.wl-badge{animation:wlb 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.wl-badge.b2{animation-direction:alternate-reverse}}
@keyframes wlf{from{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-2.5deg)}to{transform:translateY(8px) rotate(-1.5deg)}}
@keyframes wlb{from{transform:translateY(-5px)}to{transform:translateY(6px)}}
.wl-sec{padding-block:32px}
.wl-sec h2{font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,30px);text-align:center;margin-bottom:22px}
.wl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:14px}
.wl-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.wl-card h3{font-size:17px;margin:8px 0 6px}.wl-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.wl-n{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.wl-types{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
.wl-types span{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);font-weight:500}
.wl-faq{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;gap:8px}
.wl-faq details{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 18px}
.wl-faq summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}.wl-faq p{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.wl-end{text-align:center;padding-block:36px}.wl-end h2{margin-bottom:16px}

.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.stat{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px}
.stat .lb{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.stat .n{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.2;margin-top:4px}
.stat .u{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:860px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.chartbox{overflow-x:auto}
.chartbox svg{width:100%;min-width:480px;height:auto;display:block}
.chartbox .ax{fill:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:var(--ui)}
.chartbox .gl{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:1}
.chartbox .bar{fill:var(--primary)}
.chartbox .vl{fill:var(--ink);font-size:11px;font-family:var(--ui);font-weight:600}
.sec-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
@media (max-width:860px){.sec-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.sec-grid .card+.card{margin-top:0}
.feat{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:12px}
.feat li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.feat .dot{flex:none;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--ok)}
.feat .dot.off{color:var(--warn)}
.feat b{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}
.feat span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.setrow{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.setrow:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.setrow>div{min-width:0}
.setrow b{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;display:block}
.setrow span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.setrow select{width:auto}
.defs{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);display:grid;gap:4px;margin:0;padding-left:18px}
footer.foot{margin-top:28px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;max-width:78ch}

/* modal */
.mback{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(8,14,26,.55);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16px;z-index:50}
.mbox{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border-radius:14px;max-width:480px;width:100%;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto}
.mbox h2{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:8px}
.mbody{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}
.mbody ul{margin:8px 0;padding-left:20px}
.mact{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:18px}
input:focus,textarea:focus,select:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft)}
/* ---- Gen-Z glass layer: aurora background, translucent surfaces, gradient accents ---- */
.bg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.bg i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px);will-change:transform}
.bg i:nth-child(1){width:68vmax;height:46vmax;background:var(--b1);left:-18vmax;top:-16vmax;opacity:.62}
.bg i:nth-child(2){width:48vmax;height:68vmax;background:var(--b2);right:-18vmax;top:-4vmax;opacity:.56}
.bg i:nth-child(3){width:72vmax;height:44vmax;background:var(--b3);left:-2vmax;bottom:-24vmax;opacity:.5}
.bg i:nth-child(4){width:46vmax;height:34vmax;background:var(--b4);right:2vmax;bottom:-14vmax;opacity:.52}
.bg::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:150vmax;height:150vmax;margin:-75vmax 0 0 -75vmax;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0deg,var(--b1) 55deg,transparent 120deg,var(--b2) 200deg,transparent 265deg,var(--b3) 320deg,transparent 360deg);filter:blur(90px);opacity:.3;will-change:transform}
.bg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(var(--dots) 1px,transparent 1.5px);background-size:24px 24px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,transparent 80%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,transparent 80%)}
.bg .glow{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:420px;height:420px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--spot),transparent 66%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s ease;filter:none}
.bg.on .glow{opacity:1}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:40;background:var(--solid)}

.bar{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:30;background:var(--surface);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%)}
.card,.stat,.auth-card{background-color:var(--surface);border-radius:18px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(150%);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);box-shadow:var(--shadow),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.card,.stat{background-image:radial-gradient(340px circle at var(--mx,-500px) var(--my,-500px),var(--spot),transparent 70%)}
.auth-card{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:28px;border-radius:22px}
.types button,.chip,.mobtabs button,.ideas button{-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.types button{border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface)}
.chip{background:var(--surface)}
.seg button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--solid)}
.mbox{background:var(--solid);border-radius:20px}
.mback{-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
input[type=text],input[type=date],input[type=email],input[type=password],textarea,select{border-radius:10px}
.btn{border-radius:12px;background:var(--grad);border-color:transparent;color:var(--primary-ink)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;border-color:var(--line);color:var(--primary)}
.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-soft)}
.btn.g{background:var(--surface)}
.btn.danger{background:var(--danger);border-color:var(--danger)}
.btn.ghost.danger{background:transparent;border-color:var(--line)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"],.mobtabs button[aria-pressed="true"],.types button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--grad);border-color:transparent;color:var(--primary-ink)}
.avatar{background:var(--grad)}
.page-head h1{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;display:inline-block}
nav.tabs a[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--primary-soft);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
.auth-side{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(14,40,96,.86),rgba(48,40,132,.80));-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.auth-side::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:26rem;height:26rem;border-radius:50%;right:-9rem;bottom:-9rem;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(160,130,255,.55),transparent 65%)}
.auth-side>*{position:relative}
.auth-side h1{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 10%,#BFD2FF 60%,#E0CCFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.alert{background:var(--primary-soft);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.ginfo{-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}

/* attach-file + stamps + standards */
.drop{border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 14px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;display:grid;gap:2px;background:var(--primary-soft)}
.drop b{font-weight:600}
.drop span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.drop:hover,.drop.over{border-color:var(--primary)}
.drop.over{background:var(--field)}
.fileinfo{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--field)}
.fileinfo img{width:48px;height:48px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;flex:none}
.fileinfo .fi{min-width:0;flex:1}
.fileinfo .fi b{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.fileinfo .fi span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.fileact{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.sub-h{margin:16px 0 4px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.assetrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.assetrow:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.assetrow .thumb{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px;border:1px dashed var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;flex:none;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--field)}
.assetrow .thumb img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%}
.assetrow .nm{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:14px}
.assetrow .nm span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
details.card summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
details.card[open] summary{margin-bottom:10px}
details.card .defs{margin-bottom:8px}
details.card .defs b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
  .bg i:nth-child(1){animation:flow1 28s linear infinite}
  .bg i:nth-child(2){animation:flow2 34s linear infinite}
  .bg i:nth-child(3){animation:flow3 40s linear infinite}
  .bg i:nth-child(4){animation:flow4 31s linear infinite}
  .bg::before{animation:spin 80s linear infinite}
  @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  @keyframes flow1{0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0) scale(1)}20%{transform:translate3d(12vmax,8vmax,0) rotate(36deg) scale(1.1)}40%{transform:translate3d(24vmax,2vmax,0) rotate(72deg) scale(.96)}60%{transform:translate3d(20vmax,16vmax,0) rotate(108deg) scale(1.12)}80%{transform:translate3d(6vmax,12vmax,0) rotate(144deg) scale(1)}100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(180deg) scale(1)}}
  @keyframes flow2{0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0) scale(1)}20%{transform:translate3d(-10vmax,10vmax,0) rotate(-36deg) scale(1.08)}40%{transform:translate3d(-20vmax,4vmax,0) rotate(-72deg) scale(.94)}60%{transform:translate3d(-14vmax,18vmax,0) rotate(-108deg) scale(1.1)}80%{transform:translate3d(-4vmax,10vmax,0) rotate(-144deg) scale(1)}100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(-180deg) scale(1)}}
  @keyframes flow3{0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0) scale(1)}20%{transform:translate3d(14vmax,-8vmax,0) rotate(30deg) scale(1.08)}40%{transform:translate3d(26vmax,-14vmax,0) rotate(60deg) scale(.95)}60%{transform:translate3d(18vmax,-4vmax,0) rotate(90deg) scale(1.1)}80%{transform:translate3d(6vmax,-10vmax,0) rotate(120deg) scale(1)}100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(180deg) scale(1)}}
  @keyframes flow4{0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0) scale(1)}25%{transform:translate3d(-12vmax,-8vmax,0) rotate(-45deg) scale(1.12)}50%{transform:translate3d(-22vmax,-16vmax,0) rotate(-90deg) scale(.94)}75%{transform:translate3d(-8vmax,-6vmax,0) rotate(-135deg) scale(1.08)}100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(-180deg) scale(1)}}
  .btn:not(:disabled):hover{filter:brightness(1.08) saturate(1.1)}
  .drop{transition:border-color .18s,background-color .18s}
}
@media (max-width:640px){.bg i{filter:blur(56px)}}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
  .btn,.chip,.types button,.seg button,nav.tabs a,.mobtabs button,.ideas button{transition:background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .14s ease}
  .btn:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(14,34,64,.18)}
  .btn:not(:disabled):active,.chip:active,.types button:active,.mobtabs button:active{transform:scale(.97);box-shadow:none}
  .types button:hover{border-color:var(--primary);transform:translateY(-1px)}
  input,textarea,select{transition:border-color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
  .meter i{transition:background-color .25s ease}
  .stat{transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
  .stat:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  .enter{animation:eofIn .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
  .enter-soft{animation:eofSoft .24s ease both}
  .fade{animation:eofFade .22s ease both}
  .alert:not([hidden]){animation:eofSoft .25s ease both}
  .mback{animation:eofFade .16s ease both}
  .mbox{animation:eofPop .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
  .chartbox .bar{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:eofGrow .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
  @keyframes eofIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  @keyframes eofSoft{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  @keyframes eofFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
  @keyframes eofPop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  @keyframes eofGrow{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
}
/* ===== UI refresh: calmer canvas, crisp surfaces, clear hierarchy ===== */
:root{
  --bg:#F3F6FC; --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.88); --field:#FFFFFF; --line:rgba(22,46,98,.13);
  --ink:#0F1F3D; --muted:#566684; --primary:#1E4DB0; --primary-soft:rgba(30,77,176,.08);
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#1E4DB0 0%,#3557D4 100%);
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,32,70,.05),0 10px 28px rgba(16,32,70,.07);
  --shadow-lg:0 2px 6px rgba(16,32,70,.08),0 18px 44px rgba(16,32,70,.14);
  --canvas:rgba(22,46,98,.045); --r:16px;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --surface:rgba(22,32,58,.86); --field:rgba(10,17,34,.7); --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#3A64DB 0%,#5A5BE0 100%);
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.32); --shadow-lg:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5); --canvas:rgba(160,185,255,.06)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --surface:rgba(22,32,58,.86); --field:rgba(10,17,34,.7); --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#3A64DB 0%,#5A5BE0 100%);
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.32); --shadow-lg:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5); --canvas:rgba(160,185,255,.06)}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
body{line-height:1.55}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:8px}
input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:0}
/* softer aurora so content leads */
.bg i{opacity:.3!important;filter:blur(90px)}
.bg::before{opacity:.35}
/* top bar */
.bar{background:var(--surface);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(170%);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(170%);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}
.bar-in{padding-block:9px;gap:6px 20px}
nav.tabs{gap:2px}
nav.tabs a{padding:8px 15px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15.5px;position:relative;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
nav.tabs a:hover{background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--ink)}
nav.tabs a[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary);font-weight:600}
nav.tabs a[aria-current="page"]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:2px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--primary)}
.who{gap:6px}
.who .btn.sm{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:10px}
.cmdbtn{color:var(--muted)!important}
/* page head */
.page-head{margin-bottom:20px}
.page-head h1{font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,32px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.2;background:none;-webkit-background-clip:initial;background-clip:initial;color:var(--ink);display:block}
.page-head p{font-size:16px;margin-top:6px}
/* surfaces */
.card,.stat{background-color:var(--surface);background-image:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--shadow);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none}
.card{padding:20px 22px}
.card+.card{margin-top:16px}
.card h2{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.005em;margin-bottom:14px}
.stat{padding:18px 20px}
.stat .lb{font-size:14px}
.stat .n{font-size:34px;margin-top:6px}
.stats{gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
/* forms */
label{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);opacity:.82;margin:14px 0 5px}
input[type=text],input[type=date],input[type=email],input[type=password],input[type=search],input[type=number],textarea,select{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--field);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:15.5px;transition:border-color .18s,box-shadow .18s}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted);opacity:.7}
input:hover,textarea:hover,select:hover{border-color:rgba(30,77,176,.35)}
input:focus,textarea:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--primary-soft)}
.status{font-size:13.5px}
.alert{border-radius:12px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:14.5px}
/* buttons: primary solid, secondary outlined, tertiary quiet */
.btn{border-radius:12px;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.005em;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,40,110,.18),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s,border-color .2s}
.btn:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(30,77,176,.28)}
.btn:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(0) scale(.985)}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--field);border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--primary);box-shadow:none}
.btn.ghost:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--primary-soft);border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:none}
.btn.sm{padding:7px 13px;font-size:14px;border-radius:10px}
.btn.ghost.danger{color:var(--danger)}
.btn.ghost.danger:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--danger);background:transparent}
.previewbar .btn[data-act=pdf],.previewbar .btn[data-act=dl]+.btn{}
.previewbar .btn[data-act=pdf]{background:var(--field);color:var(--primary);border:1.5px solid var(--primary);box-shadow:none}
.chip{border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;background:var(--field);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--primary)}
.ideas button{background:var(--field);border:1px dashed var(--line);transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}
.ideas button:hover{border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-soft)}
/* document type tabs */
.types{gap:10px;padding:2px 2px 10px;margin-bottom:12px;scroll-snap-type:x proximity}
.types button{scroll-snap-align:start;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .18s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.types button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--primary)}
.types button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--grad);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(30,77,176,.3)}
/* write layout: form scrolls, preview stays in view */
.grid{gap:24px}
@media (min-width:961px){
  .grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,440px) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .pane-preview{position:sticky;top:76px;align-self:start;max-height:calc(100vh - 92px);overflow:auto;background:var(--canvas);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;scrollbar-width:thin}
  .pane-preview .previewbar{position:sticky;top:-14px;z-index:5;margin:-14px -14px 12px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--surface);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px 20px 0 0}
}
.stage{border-radius:8px}
.paper{box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(16,32,70,.08),0 16px 40px rgba(16,32,70,.16)}
.drop{border-radius:14px;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.previewbar .note{font-size:13px}
.check{gap:7px;font-size:14px}
details.fmt summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}
/* mobile pane switch becomes a floating pill */
@media (max-width:960px){
  .mobtabs{position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:35;width:min(340px,calc(100% - 32px));margin:0;padding:5px;gap:4px;background:var(--solid);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
  .mobtabs button{border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:10px;background:transparent;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
  .mobtabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--grad);color:#fff}
  .main{padding-bottom:84px}
}
/* auth */
.auth-card{background:var(--solid);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none;padding:30px}
.auth-card h2{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.seg{border-radius:12px;padding:4px}
.seg button{padding:9px;border-radius:9px;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.seg button[aria-selected="true"]{box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(14,34,64,.18);color:var(--primary);font-weight:600}
.auth-side{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#0E2A66 0%,#243C9C 60%,#4A3FB8 100%)}
.auth-side li i{border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(212,166,79,.2)}
.btn.g{background:var(--field);border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:none}
.btn.g:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-soft)}
/* library / dashboard polish */
.librow{background:var(--field);border-radius:14px;transition:box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s}
.librow:hover{border-color:rgba(30,77,176,.35);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.tile{background:var(--field);border-radius:16px;padding:16px}
.tile b{font-size:16px}
.hrow{border-radius:10px}
.setrow{padding:12px 0}
.sec-grid{gap:16px}
.mbox{border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
/* landing polish */
.wl-bar{padding-block:14px}
.wl-card{background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.wl-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.wl-faq details{background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:border-color .2s}
.wl-faq details[open]{border-color:var(--primary)}
.wl-types span{background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.wl-copy h1{letter-spacing:-.02em}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .bar-in{gap:6px 10px}
  .who .btn.sm{padding:6px 10px;font-size:13px}
  .card{padding:16px}
  .page-head h1{font-size:24px}
}
/* ===== UI refresh pass 2: mobile header, badges, calmer aurora ===== */
.bg i{opacity:.24!important}
.badge{white-space:nowrap;flex:none}
.btn.g span:nth-child(2){flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .bar-in{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 8px}
  .bar-in .who{margin-left:auto;gap:6px}
  .who .avatar,.who .cmdbtn{display:none}
  nav.tabs{flex:1 0 100%;order:3;margin-inline:-4px;padding-bottom:2px}
  nav.tabs a{padding:7px 12px;font-size:15px}
  .logo svg,.logo img{max-height:30px}
  .btn.g{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 10px}
  .auth-side{padding:24px 20px;gap:12px}
  .auth-main{padding-block:16px}
  .auth-card{padding:22px 18px;border-radius:20px}
}
</style>

function copy(o){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o))}
function defaultDocs(){var d={};ORDER.forEach(function(t){d[t]=copy(EX[t])});return d}

function E(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return{"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]})}
function N(s){s=String(s==null?"":s);return numerals?s.replace(/[0-9]/g,function(d){return TH[+d]}):s}
function H(s){return E(N(s)).replace(/\n/g,"<br>")}
function thaiDate(iso){var m=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso||"");if(!m)return iso||"";return(+m[3])+" "+MONTHS[+m[2]-1]+" "+(+m[1]+543)}
function lines(s){return String(s||"").split(/\n+/).map(function(x){return x.trim()}).filter(Boolean)}

/* =============== layout model: one block list feeds preview, Word and plain text =============== */
/* Specs (cm / pt): A4, margins top 1.5 bottom 2 left 3 right 2, TH SarabunPSK 16, single spacing, justified,
   emblem 3 cm centred on the page (memo: 1.5 cm top-left), paragraph indent 2.5, signature block starts at the page centre (7.5 cm from the text edge). */
var assets={emblem:null,seal:null};
var CENTER=7.5,TEXTW=16;
var _cv=null;
function mcm(text,pt,bold){
  try{
    _cv=_cv||document.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d");
    _cv.font=(bold?"700 ":"400 ")+(pt*96/72)+"px Sarabun,'TH SarabunPSK',sans-serif";
    var w=_cv.measureText(text).width/37.795;
    if(w>0)return w;
  }catch(e){}
  return String(text).replace(/[ัิ-ฺ็-๎]/g,"").length*0.26*pt/16;
}
function signLines(name,position){
  var nm=String(name||"").trim();if(nm&&!/^\(.*\)$/.test(nm))nm="("+nm+")";
  var wN=mcm(N(nm),16),pos=[];
  lines(position).forEach(function(p){
    var w=mcm(N(p),16),ind=CENTER+(wN-w)/2;
    ind=Math.min(ind,TEXTW-Math.min(w,TEXTW));ind=Math.max(ind,0);
    pos.push({t:p,ind:Math.round(ind*100)/100});
  });
  return{name:nm,pos:pos};
}
function paraBlocks(body){
  return lines(body).map(function(p){
    var m=/^([0-9๐-๙]+[.)])\s*(.*)$/.exec(p);
    return m?{k:"item",n:m[1],text:m[2],b:6}:{k:"para",text:p,b:6};
  });
}
function model(t,v){
  var B=[],d=thaiDate(v.date);
  function add(o){B.push(o)}
  function sign(gap,nm,ps){
    add({k:"blank",n:gap});
    var s=signLines(nm!==undefined?nm:v.name,ps!==undefined?ps:v.position);
    if(s.name)add({k:"signname",text:s.name});
    s.pos.forEach(function(p){add({k:"signpos",text:p.t,ind:p.ind})});
  }
  function foot(list,b){var f=list.filter(Boolean);if(f.length)add({k:"foot",lines:f,b:b})}
  if(t==="memo"){
    add({k:"memohead",text:"บันทึกข้อความ"});
    add({k:"row",label:"ส่วนราชการ",val:v.agency,big:1,leader:1,b:0});
    add({k:"row2",a:{label:"ที่",val:v.no},c:{label:"วันที่",val:d},b:6});
    add({k:"row",label:"เรื่อง",val:v.subject,big:1,leader:1,b:6});
    add({k:"row",label:"เรียน",val:v.to,b:6});
    paraBlocks(v.body).forEach(add);sign(4);
  }else if(t==="external"){
    add({k:"emblem",size:3});
    var ad=lines(v.addr).slice(0,3);
    add({k:"split",left:["ที่ "+(v.no||"")],right:ad.length?ad:[""],b:0});
    add({k:"cdate",text:d,b:6});
    add({k:"row",label:"เรื่อง",val:v.subject,b:6});
    add({k:"row",label:"เรียน",val:v.to,b:6});
    if(v.ref)add({k:"row",label:"อ้างถึง",val:v.ref,b:6});
    if(v.attach)add({k:"row",label:"สิ่งที่ส่งมาด้วย",val:v.attach,b:6});
    paraBlocks(v.body).forEach(add);
    add({k:"x0",text:v.closing||"ขอแสดงความนับถือ",b:12});
    sign(3);
    foot([v.owner,v.tel?"โทร. "+v.tel:"",v.email?"ไปรษณีย์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์ "+v.email:""],12);
  }else if(t==="stamp"){
    add({k:"emblem",size:3});
    add({k:"row",label:"ที่",val:v.no,b:0});
    add({k:"row",label:"ถึง",val:v.to,b:6});
    paraBlocks(v.body).forEach(add);
    add({k:"x0",text:v.agency||"",b:12});
    add({k:"seal",initials:v.name||""});
    add({k:"x0",text:d,b:0});
    foot([v.owner,v.tel?"โทร. "+v.tel:""],12);
  }else if(t==="order"){
    add({k:"emblem",size:3});
    add({k:"center",text:"คำสั่ง"+(v.agency||""),pt:20,bold:1,b:6});
    add({k:"center",text:"ที่ "+(v.no||""),pt:16,b:6});
    add({k:"center",text:"เรื่อง  "+(v.subject||""),pt:20,bold:1,b:6});
    add({k:"center",text:"- - - - - - - - - - - - - - -",pt:16,b:12});
    paraBlocks(v.body).forEach(add);
    add({k:"dateline",text:"สั่ง ณ วันที่ "+d,ind:5,b:12});sign(2);
  }else if(t==="announce"){
    add({k:"emblem",size:3});
    add({k:"center",text:"ประกาศ"+(v.agency||""),pt:20,bold:1,b:6});
    add({k:"center",text:"เรื่อง  "+(v.subject||""),pt:20,bold:1,b:6});
    add({k:"center",text:"- - - - - - - - - - - - - - -",pt:16,b:12});
    paraBlocks(v.body).forEach(add);
    add({k:"dateline",text:"ประกาศ ณ วันที่ "+d,ind:5,b:12});sign(2);
  }else if(t==="cert"){
    add({k:"emblem",size:3});
    add({k:"row",label:"ที่",val:v.no,b:0});
    add({k:"center",text:"หนังสือรับรอง",pt:20,bold:1,b:6});
    if(v.agency)add({k:"center",text:v.agency,pt:16,b:0});
    paraBlocks(v.body).forEach(function(x,i){if(i===0)x.b=12;add(x)});
    add({k:"dateline",text:"ให้ไว้ ณ วันที่ "+d,ind:5,b:12});sign(2);
  }
  else if(t==="minutes"){
    add({k:"center",text:"รายงานการประชุม",pt:20,bold:1,b:0});
    if(v.agency)add({k:"center",text:v.agency,pt:16,b:0});
    if(v.no)add({k:"center",text:"ครั้งที่ "+v.no,pt:16,b:0});
    add({k:"center",text:"เมื่อวันที่ "+d,pt:16,b:0});
    if(v.place)add({k:"center",text:"ณ "+v.place,pt:16,b:0});
    add({k:"center",text:"- - - - - - - - - - - - - - -",pt:16,b:6});
    add({k:"row",label:"ผู้มาประชุม",val:"",b:6});
    lines(v.attendees).forEach(function(x,i){add({k:"item",n:(i+1)+".",text:x,b:0})});
    if(lines(v.absent).length){add({k:"row",label:"ผู้ไม่มาประชุม",val:"",b:6});lines(v.absent).forEach(function(x,i){add({k:"item",n:(i+1)+".",text:x,b:0})})}
    add({k:"row",label:"เริ่มประชุมเวลา",val:v.start,b:6});
    lines(v.body).forEach(function(l){if(/^ระเบียบวาระ/.test(l))add({k:"head",text:l,b:6});else{var mm=/^([0-9๐-๙]+[.)])\s*(.*)$/.exec(l);add(mm?{k:"item",n:mm[1],text:mm[2],b:6}:{k:"para",text:l,b:6})}});
    add({k:"row",label:"เลิกประชุมเวลา",val:v.end,b:6});
    sign(3,v.name,"ผู้จดรายงานการประชุม\n"+(v.position||""));
    if(v.name2||v.position2)sign(2,v.name2,"ผู้ตรวจรายงานการประชุม\n"+(v.position2||""));
  }else if(t==="news"){
    add({k:"emblem",size:3});
    add({k:"center",text:"ข่าวประชาสัมพันธ์",pt:20,bold:1,b:6});
    if(v.agency)add({k:"center",text:v.agency,pt:16,b:0});
    if(v.no)add({k:"center",text:"ข่าวที่ "+v.no,pt:16,b:0});
    add({k:"cdate",text:d,b:0});
    add({k:"center",text:v.subject||"",pt:18,bold:1,b:6});
    add({k:"center",text:"- - - - - - - - - - - - - - -",pt:16,b:6});
    paraBlocks(v.body).forEach(add);
    foot(["ข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมติดต่อ "+(v.owner||""),v.tel?"โทร. "+v.tel:"",v.email?"ไปรษณีย์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์ "+v.email:""],12);
  }
  return B;
}

/* ---------- preview ---------- */
function embHTML(cm,a){
  return a?'<img src="'+E(a.url)+'" alt="" style="height:'+cm+'cm">':'<div class="emb" style="--s:'+cm+'cm">ตรา<br>ครุฑ</div>';
}
function mt(b){return b?' style="margin-top:'+b+'pt"':''}
function toHTML(B){
  function ls(a){return a.map(function(l){return'<div>'+H(l)+'</div>'}).join("")}
  return B.map(function(b){
    switch(b.k){
      case"emblem":return'<div class="embrow"'+mt(b.b)+'>'+embHTML(b.size,assets.emblem)+'</div>';
      case"memohead":return'<div class="memohead">'+embHTML(1.5,assets.emblem)+'<h2>'+H(b.text)+'</h2></div>';
      case"row":return'<div class="row"'+mt(b.b)+'><span class="lb'+(b.big?' big':'')+'">'+H(b.label)+'</span><span class="vl'+(b.leader?' dots':'')+'">'+H(b.val)+'</span></div>';
      case"row2":return'<div class="row2"'+mt(b.b)+'><div class="row"><span class="lb big">'+H(b.a.label)+'</span><span class="vl dots">'+H(b.a.val)+'</span></div><div class="row"><span class="lb big">'+H(b.c.label)+'</span><span class="vl dots">'+H(b.c.val)+'</span></div></div>';
      case"center":return'<div class="c"'+' style="margin-top:'+(b.b||0)+'pt;font-size:'+(b.pt||16)+'pt;'+(b.bold?'font-weight:700':'')+'">'+H(b.text)+'</div>';
      case"cdate":return'<div class="c"'+mt(b.b)+'>'+H(b.text)+'</div>';
      case"head":return'<div class="headl"'+mt(b.b)+'><b>'+H(b.text)+'</b></div>';
      case"para":return'<p class="para"'+mt(b.b)+'>'+H(b.text)+'</p>';
      case"item":return'<div class="item"'+mt(b.b)+'><span class="n">'+H(b.n)+'</span><span class="t">'+H(b.text)+'</span></div>';
      case"blank":var s="";for(var i=0;i<b.n;i++)s+='<div class="gap"></div>';return s;
      case"x0":return'<div class="x0"'+mt(b.b)+'>'+H(b.text)+'</div>';
      case"dateline":return'<div style="margin-left:'+b.ind+'cm;margin-top:'+(b.b||0)+'pt">'+H(b.text)+'</div>';
      case"signname":return'<div class="x0">'+H(b.text)+'</div>';
      case"signpos":return'<div style="margin-left:'+b.ind+'cm">'+H(b.text)+'</div>';
      case"split":return'<div class="split"'+mt(b.b)+'><div>'+ls(b.left)+'</div><div>'+ls(b.right)+'</div></div>';
      case"seal":return'<div class="sealrow"><div class="sealbox">'+(assets.seal?'<img src="'+E(assets.seal.url)+'" alt="">':'<div class="seal">ที่ประทับตรา<br>(สีแดง)</div>')+'</div>'+(b.initials?'<span class="ini">'+H(b.initials)+'</span>':'')+'</div>';
      case"foot":return'<div class="foot"'+mt(b.b)+'>'+ls(b.lines)+'</div>';
    }return"";
  }).join("");
}

/* ---------- plain text ---------- */
function toText(B){
  var o=[],pad=function(n){return new Array(Math.round(n*2.2)+1).join(" ")};
  B.forEach(function(b){
    switch(b.k){
      case"memohead":o.push(b.text);break;
      case"row":o.push(b.label+" "+b.val);break;
      case"row2":o.push(b.a.label+" "+b.a.val+"    "+b.c.label+" "+b.c.val);break;
      case"center":case"cdate":o.push(b.text);break;
      case"head":o.push(b.text);break;
      case"para":o.push("    "+b.text);break;
      case"item":o.push("    "+b.n+" "+b.text);break;
      case"blank":for(var i=0;i<b.n;i++)o.push("");break;
      case"x0":case"signname":o.push(pad(CENTER)+b.text);break;
      case"dateline":case"signpos":o.push(pad(b.ind)+b.text);break;
      case"split":b.left.forEach(function(l){o.push(l)});b.right.forEach(function(l){o.push(pad(CENTER)+l)});break;
      case"seal":o.push(pad(CENTER)+"[ที่ประทับตรา] "+(b.initials||""));break;
      case"foot":b.lines.forEach(function(l){o.push(l)});break;
    }
  });
  return N(o.join("\n"));
}

/* ---------- Word (.docx) ---------- */
function TW(cm){return Math.round(cm*567)}
function dataBytes(url){var b=atob(url.split(",")[1]),a=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)a[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return a}
function toDocx(B){
  var D=window.docx,AL=D.AlignmentType,JUST=AL.THAI_DISTRIBUTE||AL.JUSTIFIED,TS=D.TabStopType;
  var FONT={ascii:"TH SarabunPSK",hAnsi:"TH SarabunPSK",cs:"TH SarabunPSK",eastAsia:"TH SarabunPSK"};
  function R(t,o){o=o||{};var sz=(o.pt||16)*2;return new D.TextRun({text:N(t),bold:!!o.b,boldComplexScript:!!o.b,size:sz,sizeComplexScript:sz,font:FONT})}
  function TAB(){return new D.TextRun({children:[new D.Tab()],font:FONT,size:32,sizeComplexScript:32})}
  function P(ch,o){o=o||{};var b=o.b||0;delete o.b;var sp=o.spacing||{};sp.before=b*20;sp.after=0;o.spacing=sp;return new D.Paragraph(Object.assign({children:ch},o))}
  function IMG(a,hcm){var h=Math.round(hcm*37.795),w=Math.round(h*a.w/a.h);return{run:new D.ImageRun({data:dataBytes(a.url),transformation:{width:w,height:h}}),wcm:hcm*a.w/a.h}}
  var out=[];
  B.forEach(function(b){
    switch(b.k){
      case"emblem":
        if(assets.emblem){var im=IMG(assets.emblem,b.size);out.push(P([im.run],{indent:{left:TW(CENTER-im.wcm/2)}}))}
        else out.push(P([R("")],{indent:{left:TW(CENTER-b.size/2)},spacing:{line:TW(b.size),lineRule:D.LineRuleType.EXACT}}));
        break;
      case"memohead":
        var kids=[];if(assets.emblem)kids.push(IMG(assets.emblem,1.5).run);
        kids.push(TAB());kids.push(R(b.text,{b:1,pt:29}));
        out.push(P(kids,{tabStops:[{type:TS.CENTER,position:TW(CENTER)}],spacing:assets.emblem?{}:{line:TW(1.5),lineRule:D.LineRuleType.EXACT}}));
        break;
      case"row":
        var rk=[R(b.label,{b:b.big,pt:b.big?20:16}),R(" "),R(b.val)],ro={b:b.b};
        if(b.leader){rk.push(TAB());ro.tabStops=[{type:TS.RIGHT,position:TW(TEXTW),leader:D.LeaderType.DOT}]}
        out.push(P(rk,ro));break;
      case"row2":
        out.push(P([R(b.a.label,{b:1,pt:20}),R(" "),R(b.a.val),TAB(),R(b.c.label,{b:1,pt:20}),R(" "),R(b.c.val),TAB()],
          {b:b.b,tabStops:[{type:TS.LEFT,position:TW(CENTER),leader:D.LeaderType.DOT},{type:TS.RIGHT,position:TW(TEXTW),leader:D.LeaderType.DOT}]}));break;
      case"center":out.push(P([R(b.text,{b:b.bold,pt:b.pt})],{alignment:AL.CENTER,b:b.b}));break;
      case"cdate":out.push(P([R(b.text)],{alignment:AL.CENTER,b:b.b}));break;
      case"head":out.push(P([R(b.text,{b:1})],{alignment:JUST,b:b.b}));break;
      case"para":out.push(P([R(b.text)],{alignment:JUST,indent:{firstLine:TW(2.5)},b:b.b}));break;
      case"item":out.push(P([R(b.n),TAB(),R(b.text)],{alignment:JUST,indent:{left:TW(3.5),hanging:TW(1)},b:b.b}));break;
      case"blank":for(var i=0;i<b.n;i++)out.push(P([R("")]));break;
      case"x0":case"signname":out.push(P([R(b.text)],{indent:{left:TW(CENTER)},b:b.b}));break;
      case"dateline":out.push(P([R(b.text)],{indent:{left:TW(b.ind)},b:b.b}));break;
      case"signpos":out.push(P([R(b.text)],{indent:{left:TW(b.ind)}}));break;
      case"split":
        var n=Math.max(b.left.length,b.right.length);
        for(var j=0;j<n;j++)out.push(P([R(b.left[j]||""),TAB(),R(b.right[j]||"")],{tabStops:[{type:TS.LEFT,position:TW(CENTER)}],b:j===0?b.b:0}));
        break;
      case"seal":
        var sk=[];
        if(assets.seal)sk.push(IMG(assets.seal,4.5).run);else sk.push(R(""));
        if(b.initials){sk.push(TAB());sk.push(R(b.initials))}
        out.push(P(sk,{indent:{left:TW(6.5)},tabStops:[{type:TS.LEFT,position:TW(11.7)}],spacing:assets.seal?{}:{line:TW(4.5),lineRule:D.LineRuleType.EXACT}}));
        break;
      case"foot":b.lines.forEach(function(l,idx){out.push(P([R(l)],{b:idx===0?b.b:0}))});break;
    }
  });
  var pn=new D.Paragraph({alignment:AL.CENTER,children:[new D.TextRun({children:[D.PageNumber.CURRENT],font:FONT,size:30,sizeComplexScript:30})]});
  return new D.Document({
    styles:{default:{document:{run:{font:FONT,size:32,sizeComplexScript:32}}}},
    sections:[{
      properties:{titlePage:true,page:{size:{width:11906,height:16838},margin:{top:TW(1.5),right:TW(2),bottom:TW(2),left:TW(3),header:TW(0.6),footer:TW(0.8)}}},
      headers:{default:new D.Header({children:[pn]}),first:new D.Header({children:[new D.Paragraph({children:[]})]})},
      children:out}]
  });
}

function runChecks(t,v){
  var c=[],T=TYPES[t].fields.map(function(f){return f[0]});
  function add(ok,msg){c.push({ok:ok,msg:msg})}
  if(T.indexOf("subject")>=0)add(!!(v.subject||"").trim(),"มีเรื่อง");
  if(T.indexOf("to")>=0)add(!!(v.to||"").trim(),t==="stamp"?"มีผู้รับ (ถึง)":"มีผู้รับ (เรียน)");
  if(T.indexOf("date")>=0)add(!!v.date,"ระบุวันที่");
  if(T.indexOf("position")>=0)add(!!(v.name||"").trim()&&!!(v.position||"").trim(),"มีชื่อและตำแหน่งผู้ลงนาม");
  add(lines(v.body).length>0,"มีเนื้อหา");
  if(t==="memo"||t==="external"||t==="stamp"){var last=lines(v.body).pop()||"";add(/จึง.*(เรียน|แจ้ง|ทราบ)/.test(last),"ย่อหน้าสุดท้ายมีคำลงท้าย เช่น \"จึงเรียนมาเพื่อโปรดทราบ\"")}
  if(t==="announce"){var l2=lines(v.body).pop()||"";add(/ประกาศ.*ทราบ/.test(l2),"ลงท้ายด้วย \"จึงประกาศให้ทราบโดยทั่วกัน\"")}
  if(t==="minutes"){add(lines(v.attendees).length>0,"มีรายชื่อผู้มาประชุม");add(!!(v.start||"").trim()&&!!(v.end||"").trim(),"ระบุเวลาเริ่มและเลิกประชุม");add(!!(v.name||"").trim(),"มีผู้จดรายงานการประชุม");add(/ระเบียบวาระ/.test(v.body||""),"เนื้อหามี \"ระเบียบวาระที่ ...\"")}
  if(t==="news"){add(!!(v.owner||"").trim()&&!!(v.tel||"").trim(),"มีผู้ประสานงานและเบอร์โทรสำหรับสื่อ")}
  if(T.indexOf("no")>=0&&t!=="order"){add(!!(v.no||"").trim(),"มีเลขที่หนังสือ (กดปุ่มออกเลขที่ได้)")}
  if(T.indexOf("no")>=0&&(v.no||"").trim()){var dup=lib.filter(function(x){return x.type===t&&x.id!==libLink[t]&&(x.no||"").trim()===v.no.trim()}).length;add(dup===0,dup?"เลขที่ซ้ำกับเอกสารอื่นในคลัง "+dup+" ฉบับ":"เลขที่ไม่ซ้ำในคลัง")}
  if(v.date){var dd=new Date(v.date+"T00:00:00");add(!(dd.getTime()-Date.now()>7*864e5),"วันที่ไม่ล่วงหน้าเกิน 7 วัน")}
  var allText=lines(v.body).join(" ")+" "+(v.subject||""),informal=(allText.match(/ค่ะ|ครับ|นะคะ|นะครับ|หน่อย|เดี๋ยว|อยากจะ|ยังไง|เยอะ|ไม่ได้ละ/g)||[]);
  add(informal.length===0,informal.length?"พบคำไม่เป็นทางการ: "+informal.filter(function(x,i,a){return a.indexOf(x)===i}).join(", "):"ภาษาเป็นทางการ ไม่พบคำพูดทั่วไป");
  if(T.indexOf("subject")>=0&&t!=="news")add((v.subject||"").length<=120,"เรื่องกระชับ ไม่เกิน 120 ตัวอักษร");
  add(!/ {2,}/.test(JSON.stringify(v).replace(/\\n/g," ")),"ไม่มีเว้นวรรคซ้อนกันหลายช่อง");
  var m=(JSON.stringify(v).match(/\[ระบุ[^\]]*\]/g)||[]).length;
  add(m===0,m?"ยังมีช่องที่ต้องเติมอีก "+m+" จุด (ข้อความในวงเล็บเหลี่ยม)":"ไม่มีช่องค้างเติม");
  return c;
}

/* =============== sensitive-data detection =============== */
function d2a(s){return s.replace(/[๐-๙]/g,function(c){return String(TH.indexOf(c))})}
function thaiIdOk(s){var d=s.replace(/\D/g,"");if(d.length!==13)return false;var sum=0;for(var i=0;i<12;i++)sum+=(+d[i])*(13-i);return((11-sum%11)%10)===+d[12]}
function luhnOk(s){var d=s.replace(/\D/g,"");if(d.length<15||d.length>16)return false;var sum=0,alt=false;for(var i=d.length-1;i>=0;i--){var n=+d[i];if(alt){n*=2;if(n>9)n-=9}sum+=n;alt=!alt}return sum%10===0}
var PII=[
 {t:"เลขบัตรประชาชน",tok:"[เลขบัตรประชาชน]",re:/(?<!\d)\d[ -]?\d{4}[ -]?\d{5}[ -]?\d{2}[ -]?\d(?!\d)/g,ok:thaiIdOk},
 {t:"เลขบัตรเครดิต",tok:"[เลขบัตร]",re:/(?<!\d)(?:\d[ -]?){15}\d(?!\d)/g,ok:luhnOk},
 {t:"อีเมล",tok:"[อีเมล]",re:/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g},
 {t:"เบอร์โทรศัพท์",tok:"[เบอร์โทร]",re:/(?<!\d)0[2-9]\d?[ -]?\d{3,4}[ -]?\d{4}(?!\d)/g},
 {t:"เลขบัญชีธนาคาร",tok:"[เลขบัญชี]",re:/(?<!\d)\d{3}-\d-\d{5}-\d(?!\d)/g}
];
function findPII(s){
  var m=d2a(String(s||"")),hits=[];
  PII.forEach(function(p){p.re.lastIndex=0;var x;while((x=p.re.exec(m))){
    var a=x.index,b=a+x[0].length;
    if(p.ok&&!p.ok(x[0]))continue;
    if(hits.some(function(h){return a<h.b&&b>h.a}))continue;
    hits.push({a:a,b:b,t:p.t,tok:p.tok})}});
  return hits.sort(function(x,y){return x.a-y.a});
}
function maskText(s){s=String(s||"");var h=findPII(s),o="",p=0;h.forEach(function(x){o+=s.slice(p,x.a)+x.tok;p=x.b});return{text:o+s.slice(p),n:h.length}}
var SKIP_PII={tel:1,email:1,date:1};
function scanDoc(v){var out=[];Object.keys(v).forEach(function(k){if(SKIP_PII[k])return;findPII(v[k]).forEach(function(h){out.push({k:k,t:h.t})})});return out}
function maskDoc(v){var o=copy(v),n=0;Object.keys(o).forEach(function(k){if(SKIP_PII[k]||typeof o[k]!=="string")return;var r=maskText(o[k]);o[k]=r.text;n+=r.n});return{doc:o,n:n}}
function summarize(list){var c={};list.forEach(function(x){c[x.t]=(c[x.t]||0)+1});return Object.keys(c).map(function(k){return k+" "+c[k]+" รายการ"})}

/* =============== crypto + account storage =============== */
var enc=new TextEncoder(),dec=new TextDecoder();
function b64(buf){var a=new Uint8Array(buf),s="";for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)s+=String.fromCharCode(a[i]);return btoa(s)}
function unb64(s){var b=atob(s),a=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)a[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return a}
function rnd(n){return crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(n))}
async function pbk(pw,salt,label){
  var km=await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw",enc.encode(pw),"PBKDF2",false,["deriveBits"]);
  var lb=enc.encode(label),s=new Uint8Array(salt.length+lb.length);s.set(salt);s.set(lb,salt.length);
  return crypto.subtle.deriveBits({name:"PBKDF2",hash:"SHA-256",salt:s,iterations:150000},km,256);
}
function aesKey(bits){return crypto.subtle.importKey("raw",bits,"AES-GCM",false,["encrypt","decrypt"])}
async function seal(key,obj){var iv=rnd(12);var ct=await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:"AES-GCM",iv:iv},key,enc.encode(JSON.stringify(obj)));return b64(iv)+"."+b64(ct)}
async function unseal(key,str){try{var p=str.split(".");var pt=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:"AES-GCM",iv:unb64(p[0])},key,unb64(p[1]));return JSON.parse(dec.decode(pt))}catch(e){return null}}
function eqStr(a,b){if(a.length!==b.length)return false;var r=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)r|=a.charCodeAt(i)^b.charCodeAt(i);return r===0}
function lsGet(k){try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(e){return null}}
function lsSet(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v);return true}catch(e){return false}}
function lsDel(k){try{localStorage.removeItem(k)}catch(e){}}

var userCap=null,dbH=null,uid=null,sampleFn=null,dlCap=null,capsDone=false;
var capsReady=(async function(){
  try{if(window.claude){
    userCap=await window.claude.use("user");dbH=await window.claude.use("db");
    sampleFn=await window.claude.use("sample");dlCap=await window.claude.use("downloads");
    if(userCap){try{uid=await userCap.id()}catch(e){}}
  }}catch(e){}
  capsDone=true;
})();

function acctPath(){return"data/users/"+uid+"/account"}
async function loadAcct(email){
  email=(email||"").toLowerCase();
  if(dbH&&uid){try{var s=await dbH.doc(acctPath()).get();if(s.exists){var a=s.data();if(!email||String(a.email).toLowerCase()===email)return{a:a,where:"db"}}}catch(e){}}
  try{var m=JSON.parse(lsGet("eof-accounts")||"{}");if(m[email])return{a:m[email],where:"local"}}catch(e){}
  return null;
}
async function saveAcct(a){
  if(dbH&&uid){try{await dbH.doc(acctPath()).set(a);return"db"}catch(e){}}
  var m={};try{m=JSON.parse(lsGet("eof-accounts")||"{}")}catch(e){}
  m[a.email.toLowerCase()]=a;if(!lsSet("eof-accounts",JSON.stringify(m)))throw new Error("storage");return"local";
}
async function removeAcct(a,where){
  if(where==="db"&&dbH&&uid){try{await dbH.doc(acctPath()).delete()}catch(e){}}
  try{var m=JSON.parse(lsGet("eof-accounts")||"{}");delete m[a.email.toLowerCase()];lsSet("eof-accounts",JSON.stringify(m))}catch(e){}
}
function lockInfo(k){try{return JSON.parse(lsGet(k||"eof-lock")||"{}")}catch(e){return{}}}
function noteFail(k){k=k||"eof-lock";var L=lockInfo(k);L.n=(L.n||0)+1;if(L.n>=3)L.until=Date.now()+Math.min(300,Math.pow(2,L.n-2))*1000;lsSet(k,JSON.stringify(L))}
function clearFail(k){lsDel(k||"eof-lock")}
/* recovery code: 20 symbols (100 bits). A random data key (DK) encrypts drafts; DK is wrapped once by the password and once by the recovery code */
var RALPHA="ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
function genCode(){var r=rnd(20),s="";for(var i=0;i<20;i++){s+=RALPHA.charAt(r[i]%32);if(i%4===3&&i<19)s+="-"}return s}
function normCode(c){return String(c||"").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,"")}
async function wrapRecovery(a,dk,code){
  var n=normCode(code),rs=rnd(16);
  a.rsalt=b64(rs);a.rvh=b64(await pbk(n,rs,"v"));
  a.rwk=await seal(await aesKey(await pbk(n,rs,"k")),{dk:b64(dk)});a.rcreated=Date.now();
}
function strength(p){var s=0;if(p.length>=10)s++;if(p.length>=14)s++;if(/[a-z]/.test(p)&&/[A-Z]/.test(p))s++;if(/\d/.test(p))s++;if(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(p))s++;return s}
function validEmail(e){return/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(e)}

/* =============== drafts (AES-GCM, key only in memory) =============== */
var saveT;
function saveDrafts(){clearTimeout(saveT);saveT=setTimeout(flush,400)}
async function flush(){clearTimeout(saveT);if(!S.key)return;try{lsSet("eof-drafts-"+S.id,await seal(S.key,{docs:docs,cur:cur,numerals:numerals,settings:settings,assets:assets,lib:lib.concat(libHidden),seq:seq,libLink:libLink}))}catch(e){}}
async function loadDrafts(){
  docs=defaultDocs();cur="memo";assets.emblem=null;assets.seal=null;lib=[];libHidden=[];seq={};libLink={};libOpen=null;
  var raw=lsGet("eof-drafts-"+S.id);if(!raw)return;
  var o=await unseal(S.key,raw);if(!o)return;
  if(o.docs)ORDER.forEach(function(t){if(o.docs[t])docs[t]=o.docs[t]});
  if(o.cur&&ORDER.indexOf(o.cur)>=0)cur=o.cur;if(o.numerals===false)numerals=false;
  if(o.settings)settings=Object.assign(settings,o.settings);
  if(o.assets){assets.emblem=o.assets.emblem||null;assets.seal=o.assets.seal||null}
  if(Array.isArray(o.lib)){var all=o.lib.filter(function(x){return x&&TYPES[x.type]&&x.doc});lib=all.filter(function(x){return ORDER.indexOf(x.type)>=0});libHidden=all.filter(function(x){return ORDER.indexOf(x.type)<0})}
  if(o.seq&&typeof o.seq==="object")seq=o.seq;if(o.libLink&&typeof o.libLink==="object")libLink=o.libLink;
}

/* =============== document library, numbering, approval status =============== */
var STATUSES=["ร่าง","รอตรวจ","รอลงนาม","ลงนามแล้ว","ส่งแล้ว"];
var libFilter={q:"",t:"",s:""},libOpen=null;
function beYear(iso){return(+String(iso||TODAY).slice(0,4))+543}
function noKey(t,iso){return t+"-"+beYear(iso)}
function fmtNo(t,n,iso){var y=beYear(iso),pre=(settings.noPrefix||"").trim();if(t==="order"||t==="minutes")return n+"/"+y;return pre?pre+"/"+n:n+"/"+y}
function issueNo(){
  var t=cur,v=docs[t],k=noKey(t,v.date);seq[k]=(seq[k]||0)+1;
  v.no=fmtNo(t,seq[k],v.date);
  var f=document.getElementById("f_"+t+"_no");if(f)f.value=v.no;
  drawPreview();saveDrafts();dlStatus("ออกเลขที่ "+v.no+" แล้ว (เลขล่าสุดของปี "+beYear(v.date)+" คือ "+seq[k]+")");
}
function libItem(id){for(var i=0;i<lib.length;i++)if(lib[i].id===id)return lib[i];return null}
function docTitle(t,v){return(v.subject||v.agency||TYPES[t].label)}
function newId(){return b64(rnd(9)).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g,"x")}
function saveToLib(){
  var t=cur,v=docs[t],it=libItem(libLink[t]),now=Date.now(),snap=copy(v);
  if(it){
    if(JSON.stringify(it.doc)!==JSON.stringify(snap)){it.vers.unshift({t:it.updated,doc:it.doc});it.vers=it.vers.slice(0,10);it.doc=snap}
    it.title=docTitle(t,v);it.no=v.no||"";it.date=v.date||"";it.updated=now;
    dlStatus("อัปเดตเอกสารในคลังแล้ว (เก็บเวอร์ชันเดิมไว้ "+it.vers.length+" เวอร์ชัน)");
  }else{
    it={id:newId(),type:t,title:docTitle(t,v),no:v.no||"",date:v.date||"",status:"ร่าง",notes:"",created:now,updated:now,doc:snap,vers:[]};
    lib.unshift(it);if(lib.length>200)lib.length=200;libLink[t]=it.id;dlStatus("บันทึกลงคลังเอกสารแล้ว ดูได้ที่เมนู คลังเอกสาร");
  }
  saveDrafts();
}
function fmtDT(ms){var d=new Date(ms);return N(d.getDate()+" "+MS[d.getMonth()]+" "+(d.getFullYear()+543)+" "+pad(d.getHours())+":"+pad(d.getMinutes()))}
function filteredLib(){
  var q=libFilter.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  return lib.filter(function(x){
    if(libFilter.t&&x.type!==libFilter.t)return false;
    if(libFilter.s&&x.status!==libFilter.s)return false;
    if(q&&(x.title+" "+x.no+" "+x.notes+" "+TYPES[x.type].label).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)return false;
    return true;
  });
}
function viewLibrary(){
  var yr=beYear(TODAY);
  app.innerHTML=shell("library",
   '<div class="stats" id="libStats"></div>'+
   '<div class="card"><div class="libbar"><input type="search" id="libQ" data-lq placeholder="ค้นหาเลขที่ เรื่อง หรือโน้ต" aria-label="ค้นหา" value="'+E(libFilter.q)+'">'+
    '<select data-lf="t" aria-label="กรองตามชนิด"><option value="">ทุกชนิด</option>'+ORDER.map(function(t){return'<option value="'+t+'"'+(libFilter.t===t?' selected':'')+'>'+TYPES[t].label+'</option>'}).join("")+'</select>'+
    '<select data-lf="s" aria-label="กรองตามสถานะ"><option value="">ทุกสถานะ</option>'+STATUSES.map(function(s){return'<option'+(libFilter.s===s?' selected':'')+'>'+s+'</option>'}).join("")+'</select>'+
    '<button class="btn ghost sm" type="button" data-act="libcsv">ส่งออกทะเบียน CSV</button></div>'+
    '<div class="status" id="libStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><div id="libList"></div></div>'+
   '<div class="card"><h2>ตั้งค่าเลขที่หนังสือ</h2><div class="numgrid"><div><label for="npre">คำนำหน้าเลขที่ (เช่น ศธ 0001)</label><input type="text" id="npre" data-npre value="'+E(settings.noPrefix||"")+'" placeholder="เว้นว่างจะออกเป็น 1/'+N(yr)+'"></div></div>'+
    '<div class="sub-h">เลขที่ล่าสุดที่ออกแล้วของปี '+N(yr)+' (แก้เพื่อต่อจากเลขเดิมที่ใช้อยู่)</div><div class="numgrid">'+
    ORDER.map(function(t){var k=noKey(t,TODAY);return'<div><label for="sq_'+t+'">'+TYPES[t].label+'</label><input type="number" min="0" inputmode="numeric" id="sq_'+t+'" data-seq="'+k+'" value="'+(seq[k]||0)+'"></div>'}).join("")+
    '</div><p class="hint">กด "ออกเลขที่" ข้างช่องเลขที่ในหน้าเขียนเอกสาร ระบบจะใส่เลขถัดไปให้ ไม่ซ้ำกัน</p></div>',
   '<h1>คลังเอกสาร</h1><p>ทะเบียนหนังสือที่บันทึกไว้ ติดตามสถานะการอนุมัติ ดูเวอร์ชันย้อนหลัง และเปิดกลับมาแก้ไข</p>');
  drawLibStats();drawLib();
}
function drawLibStats(){
  var el=$("#libStats");if(!el)return;
  var c={};STATUSES.forEach(function(s){c[s]=0});lib.forEach(function(x){c[x.status]=(c[x.status]||0)+1});
  el.innerHTML=[["ทั้งหมด",lib.length],["ร่าง",c["ร่าง"]],["รอตรวจ/รอลงนาม",c["รอตรวจ"]+c["รอลงนาม"]],["ลงนาม/ส่งแล้ว",c["ลงนามแล้ว"]+c["ส่งแล้ว"]]].map(function(x){return'<div class="stat"><div class="lb">'+x[0]+'</div><div class="n">'+N(x[1])+'</div><div class="u">ฉบับ</div></div>'}).join("");
}
function drawLib(){
  var el=$("#libList");if(!el)return;
  var L=filteredLib();
  if(!L.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty">'+(lib.length?'ไม่พบรายการที่ตรงกับตัวกรอง':'ยังไม่มีเอกสารในคลัง เปิดหน้า เขียนเอกสาร แล้วกด "บันทึกลงคลัง" เพื่อเริ่มสร้างทะเบียน')+'</div>';return}
  el.innerHTML=L.map(function(x){
    var open=libOpen===x.id;
    return'<div class="librow'+(open?' open':'')+'"><div class="lr-main">'+
     '<div class="lr-no">'+(x.no?H(x.no):'<span class="muted">ไม่มีเลขที่</span>')+'</div>'+
     '<div class="lr-t"><b>'+H(x.title)+'</b><span>'+E(TYPES[x.type].label)+' · '+H(thaiDate(x.date)||"ไม่ระบุวันที่")+' · แก้ล่าสุด '+fmtDT(x.updated)+'</span></div>'+
     '<select class="lr-st" data-lst="'+x.id+'" data-s="'+STATUSES.indexOf(x.status)+'" aria-label="สถานะ">'+STATUSES.map(function(s){return'<option'+(s===x.status?' selected':'')+'>'+s+'</option>'}).join("")+'</select>'+
     '<div class="lr-act"><button class="btn sm" type="button" data-act="libopen" data-id="'+x.id+'">เปิดแก้ไข</button><button class="btn ghost sm" type="button" data-act="libtoggle" data-id="'+x.id+'" aria-expanded="'+open+'">รายละเอียด</button></div></div>'+
     (open?'<div class="lr-more"><label for="ln_'+x.id+'">โน้ต/ความเห็นผู้ตรวจ</label><textarea id="ln_'+x.id+'" rows="2" data-lnote="'+x.id+'" placeholder="เช่น ให้แก้ย่อหน้าที่ 2 ก่อนเสนอลงนาม">'+E(x.notes||"")+'</textarea>'+
       '<div class="sub-h">เวอร์ชันย้อนหลัง ('+N(x.vers.length)+')</div>'+
       (x.vers.length?x.vers.map(function(vv,i){return'<div class="verrow"><span>'+fmtDT(vv.t)+' · '+H(docTitle(x.type,vv.doc))+'</span><button class="btn ghost sm" type="button" data-act="libres" data-id="'+x.id+'" data-i="'+i+'">กู้คืนเวอร์ชันนี้</button></div>'}).join(""):'<p class="hint">ยังไม่มีเวอร์ชันเก่า (ระบบเก็บเมื่อกดบันทึกซ้ำหลังแก้ไข สูงสุด 10 เวอร์ชัน)</p>')+
       '<div class="row-actions"><button class="btn ghost sm" type="button" data-act="libdup" data-id="'+x.id+'">ทำสำเนา</button><button class="btn ghost sm danger" type="button" data-act="libdel" data-id="'+x.id+'">ลบ</button></div></div>':'')+
    '</div>';
  }).join("");
}
function libCSV(){
  function q(s){s=String(s==null?"":s);return'"'+s.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"'}
  var rows=[["เลขที่","ชนิด","เรื่อง","วันที่","สถานะ","แก้ไขล่าสุด","โน้ต"]];
  lib.forEach(function(x){rows.push([x.no,TYPES[x.type].label,x.title,x.date,x.status,new Date(x.updated).toISOString(),x.notes])});
  return"﻿"+rows.map(function(r){return r.map(q).join(",")}).join("\r\n");
}
function openFromLib(id){
  var it=libItem(id);if(!it)return;
  docs[it.type]=copy(it.doc);cur=it.type;libLink[it.type]=it.id;saveDrafts();
  if(location.hash==="#write")render();else location.hash="#write";
}
function newBlank(t){
  var keep=["agency","addr","name","position","name2","position2","owner","tel","email","closing","place"],old=docs[t]||{},v=copy(EX[t]);
  Object.keys(v).forEach(function(k){v[k]=keep.indexOf(k)>=0?(old[k]||v[k]):""});
  v.date=TODAY;if(t==="external")v.closing=old.closing||"ขอแสดงความนับถือ";
  docs[t]=v;libLink[t]=null;cur=t;saveDrafts();
}
function askNewBlank(t){
  t=t||cur;
  modal({title:"เริ่มเอกสารใหม่ชนิด "+TYPES[t].label,html:"<p>ร่างปัจจุบันของชนิดนี้จะถูกล้าง (เก็บข้อมูลผู้ส่ง ผู้ลงนาม และหน่วยงานไว้) ต้องการบันทึกร่างปัจจุบันลงคลังก่อนไหม</p>",
    actions:[{label:"ยกเลิก",cls:"ghost"},{label:"ล้างโดยไม่บันทึก",cls:"ghost",fn:function(){newBlank(t);if(view==="write"){drawTypes();drawFields();drawPreview();dlStatus("เริ่มเอกสารใหม่แล้ว")}else location.hash="#write"}},
      {label:"บันทึกลงคลังแล้วเริ่มใหม่",fn:function(){var c0=cur;cur=t;saveToLib();cur=c0;newBlank(t);if(view==="write"){drawTypes();drawFields();drawPreview();dlStatus("บันทึกลงคลังแล้ว และเริ่มเอกสารใหม่")}else location.hash="#write"}}]});
}

    '<p class="hint">กดแล้วเปิดร่างล่าสุดของชนิดนั้น หรือกด "เอกสารใหม่" ในหน้าเขียนเอกสารเพื่อเริ่มฉบับใหม่ · กด Ctrl+K เพื่อค้นหาคำสั่งได้ทุกหน้า</p></div>'+

   '<div class="card"><h2>แก้ไขล่าสุด</h2>'+(rec.length?rec.map(row).join(""):'<p class="hint">ยังไม่มีเอกสารในคลัง เริ่มจากเลือกชนิดเอกสารด้านบน แล้วกด "บันทึกลงคลัง"</p>')+'</div></div>',
